simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to דַּךְ (H1790) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: a.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: דַּךְ (dak) means crushed , i.e. (figuratively) injured First listed occurrence: Prov 26 28.

definitions.full: H1790. dak דַּךְ adjective crushed, oppressed — דַּךְ Psa 74:21 ; דָּ֑ךְ 9:10 ; 10:18 ; plural suffix דַּכָּ֑ו Prov 26:28 (Baer; and other editions דַּכָּיו ) — in poetry; always figurative, oppressed, distressed Psa 9:10 Psalm 18 (|| יתום ) 74:21 (|| עָנִי and אביון ); Prov 26:28 דַּכָּו = those crushed by it (a lying tongue).
